svg.title: WP-C-04 Figure 4-2: how the concept holds each safety goal
svg.desc: How the concept holds each safety goal. SG-01 (ASIL D): EL-02 bounds, then brakes; the vehicle is held at standstill. SG-02 (ASIL D): EL-02 brakes; the vehicle is stops before the crosswalk. SG-03 (ASIL C): EL-02 limits unconfirmed braking; the vehicle is the car behind keeps its gap. SG-04 (ASIL D): EL-02 rejects the steering; the vehicle is stopped in its lane. SG-05 (ASIL D): EL-02 holds, EL-05 park brake; the vehicle is held, park brake on. SG-06 (ASIL D): EL-02 refuses entry; the vehicle is stops at the line. SG-07 (ASIL D): EL-02 detects the loss; the vehicle is stopped in lane, hazards on. SG-08 (ASIL C): EL-02 rejects the old command; the vehicle is stopped and held. SG-09 (ASIL C): EL-02: signals left, turns right; the vehicle is hazard lights warn the cyclist.
